decisions.rationale: First project reached day 3 (2026-08-23) shows real engagement, but no invite and no key milestone by day 6, and Sofia never replied to either outreach ([email:e4609e9c], [email:4d0bdf17]) despite the onboarding call being held ([calendar:0af3306d]). No tickets, so no blocker signal. 8 days left gives moderate odds.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for getting Blue Analytics' first project up last week -- that's the hardest part. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the natural next step is putting real work into that project and bringing in whoever shares it with you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the next step with you live.

Best,
Priya
